title: uuencoding: BlockMetadata, DecodedBlock, ScannedBlock missing Eq derive
description:
Why this exists: uuencoding/src/lib.rs derives PartialEq but not Eq on BlockMetadata, DecodedBlock, and ScannedBlock. All fields of these types are u32, String, Vec<u8>, bool, and Option<T> — all of which implement Eq. PartialEq without Eq is only correct when the type has floating-point fields or similar non-reflexive equality, which is not the case here.

What goes wrong: these types cannot be stored in HashSet or used as HashMap keys (those require Eq), and assertions in downstream crates that want assert_eq! with fine-grained hash-map grouping will hit a trait-bound error. The omission of Eq when PartialEq is derived and all fields are Eq is an oversight that misleads readers into thinking the type has non-reflexive equality.

Fix: add Eq to the derive lists for BlockMetadata, DecodedBlock, and ScannedBlock.
